chunks.rationale: The only production behavior change this turn: resolve the chip as started immediately after a successful fork, then startRun. A startRun throw used to leave the chip open so a retry forked a second idle thread.
risks: If resolveSuggestion fails after fork, the user still has an idle fork (same as before) and the chip stays open — retry still forks again. That path is rare (unknown thread/id) and not worse than the previous startRun-first order.

chunks.rationale: App+useCoder wiring for the three chip actions. Pins fork(worktree:true) → resolve(started) → runs.start order, startRun-fail still resolves, file create+resolve, in-band create failure leaves the chip open, dismiss starts nothing.
Pins the strip after the empty-inline prompt so chips are not trapped in a message-only branch.
fork honors worktree→pendingWorktree; issues.create is overridable so the file-failure test can return {ok:false} instead of throwing (production never throws).
